name: Ooedo Tantei Kamiya Ukyou Vol. 2
original_name: 大江戸探偵 神谷右京 Ｖｏｌ２
source:
Ukyo was introduced to a client, but that client was found dead hanging on a rope. Moreover, Ukyo was attacked by someone shortly. Now it's his duty to investigate the truth behind the incidents.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
右京经人介绍认识了一名委托人，对方不久后却被发现吊死。随后，右京本人也遭到神秘人物袭击。如今，他必须查明这一连串事件背后的真相。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
